text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-Mediterranean forum, to be held in Algiers attended by six foreign ministers and high-ranking diplomats, "is first big diplomatic and political meeting in Algeria for several years...a sign that the Algerian capital is no longer regarded as before and has regained a place on the international scene."
- Bomb in cinema in Algiers, about 20 wounded.
- Two children found dead with throats slit in Bougara area south of Algiers. "Terrorist" killers stole sheep being tended by the boys, aged nine and 10.
- One dead, 37 wounded in cinema bomb blast in Algiers.
- Algiers comes out of its isolation with meeting of Mediterranean forum.
- Different groups in parliament making efforts to cohabit.
- Bomb explosion in Belcourt area cinema kills four, wounds 30.
